task: Three documents describe retention here and they do not agree: the Q1 2025 special analysis report, the feature retention rate analysis, and `lifecycle_operations_strategy_execution_effect_tracking_2024h2.xlsx`. They cover different periods and different cuts of the user base. Write one account of what is actually happening, using the stage definitions in `user_lifecycle_stage_definition_and_segmentation_standards.xlsx` to keep the vocabulary consistent, and state clearly which claims are supported by more than one source and which rest on a single one. Put every figure you cite into a companion file with the document it came from, so a reader can check any number without opening all three. Where two sources cover the same period and disagree, do not average them — record both figures and say which methodology you find more credible and why, because the disagreement itself tells you something about how retention is being measured that neither document admits.
